g.title: PIBOT_X
g.text: slot 1 green terminal (X, routing jumpers in)
Slot 1's StepStick socket stays EMPTY. Match the silkscreen names.

g.title: DM542T_SIG
g.text: Short jumper PUL- to DIR-. ENA+ and ENA- stay empty.
DIP switches 1-8: OFF ON OFF OFF ON ON OFF ON.

g.title: DM542T_HV
g.text: Follow the labels printed on the driver, not this order.
